name: coaching-session-plan
description: Write a training session plan for a sports team or group: one objective, a timed sequence from warm-up to game-related practice to cool-down, the coaching points for each part, how to make each activity easier or harder, equipment and space, and safety checks. Use when asked to plan tonight's training, write a session plan, give me drills for passing, a 60-minute session for under-9s, or I have twenty kids and half a pitch. Produces a timed session plan, a pitch or court set-up description, coaching points, progressions and regressions, and three questions to review the session.
